liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rosemary** (3 reviews): Rare live Rosemary, played by Jerry in a very quiet way that drifts into tuning before the next song; Reviewer calls it the only Rosemary [4][6][8]
- **New Potato Caboose** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds New Potato Caboose real nice, with stellar guitar from Jerry; New Potato Caboose is the standout of the show for this reviewer, who found it transporting [12][14]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Morning Dew flowing into And We Bid You Goodnight is the uncut stretch and a worthy listen; Morning Dew is great, followed by a snappy And We Bid You Goodnight [4][12]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Garcia has an inter-galactic tone in Dark Star, typical of the period [9]
- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (1 review): Country-tinged version: acoustic Weir, light keys and country-style electric Jerry in a soft instrumental intro [10]
- **The 11 Jam** (1 other source): The Eleven here is only the opening jam [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Rosemary**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd68-12-07.sbd.naines.16944.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 88 min; rated 4.31/5 by 29 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is good, but many partial cuts; Morning Dew into the closing goodnight tune is intact and worth hearing; It Hurts Me Too has its beginning chopped off on this tape; Tape is hissy and the editing is sloppy, with the show sliced up [4][5][7][9][11][12]
- **gd1968-12-07.sbd.miller.88674.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 88 min; rated 3.15/5 by 13 [3]
- **gd1968-12-07.sbd.lai.20007.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 88 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- College is now a university with a small, laid-back campus in an older residential neighborhood, not downtown [6]
- Reportedly a war protest event, with local bluegrass bands and an art school event beforehand; a friend's father attended [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-12-07.sbd.naines.16944.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by D. Litfin and Wilbur Haines; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred through CM and C1 to DAT then CDR; seeded to etree by D Litfin, shn encoding by Wilbur Haines [1]
- **gd1968-12-07.sbd.miller.88674.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D [3]. Also: This version had minor cleanup and level adjustments [3]
- **gd1968-12-07.sbd.lai.20007.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: SBD>CM>C1>DAT>CDR>CDR [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Bellarmine College, Louisville Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1968/artwork/bellarmine-college-louisville-poster) [17]
- Fan art by Leah Wilkinson: [Celebrating 50 years of the Grateful Dead at Bellarmine](https://www.knightsmedianetwork.org/post/celebrating-50-years-of-the-grateful-dead-at-bellarmine) [18]
